'''Douzler''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Rutian/Legends|Rutian]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Scavenger/Legends|scavenger]] who lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He was a crew member of the [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] ''[[Wandering P'orp]]''.
